HEATHEN-ONLY EVENTS (HE-01 to HE-45, draft for the owner, 2026-11-23, target v1.35.98)

collection.description: A Heathen with a gift for finding sweet roots comes back with a basketful for the whole camp.

description_variants.description: An Isolan with a gift for finding sweet roots comes back with a basketful for the whole camp.

setup.name: The scene
setup.text: (name1) has a gift for finding the sweet roots under the island's scrub. Today (he/she) comes back with a basketful and the whole camp eats well. (He/she) is unbearably smug about it all evening, and everybody lets (him/her) be.
